title: The Last Supper

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the evening of the Passover, Jesus and the Twelve gathered in an upper room in Jerusalem.

bsb: Lord, are You going to wash my feet?
kjv: Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

bsb: You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.
kjv: What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

bsb: Never shall You wash my feet!
kjv: Thou shalt never wash my feet.

bsb: Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.
kjv: If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

puzzle.prompt: What did Jesus do for His disciples at supper?
puzzle.hint: Jesus took a towel and a basin of water.

scenes.title: One of You Will Betray Me
scenes.note: John's Gospel calls one disciple “the one whom Jesus loved.” He isn't named; Christians have long believed it was John.

bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.
kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

bsb: Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
kjv: And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

bsb: What you are about to do, do quickly.
A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another. By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.
kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another. By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

puzzle.hint: This is how people will know we follow Jesus.

bsb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another.
kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another;

scenes.title: Do This in Remembrance of Me
scenes.note: Scholars disagree about whether Judas left before or after Jesus shared the bread and the cup. This game follows Robertson's Harmony, which places Judas leaving first.

bsb: I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
kjv: With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

bsb: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying,
kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying,

bsb: This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.
kjv: This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

bsb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying,
kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying,

bsb: This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
kjv: This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

puzzle.prompt: Put the Last Supper in order.

events.text: Judas goes out into the night
Jesus gives a new commandment: love one another
Jesus shares the bread and the cup

puzzle.hint: It begins with a towel and a basin.

bsb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

reflect: On His last night, Jesus served His friends like a servant and asked them to love one another the way He loved them.
discuss: Jesus is the Lord, but He washed His disciples' feet. What does that teach us?
Jesus knew Judas would betray Him, but He still washed his feet and shared the meal. What does that tell us about Jesus' love?
Jesus said to remember Him when we share the bread and cup. How does your church remember Jesus?
prayer: Lord Jesus, You loved Your friends to the very end. Help us serve others and love one another as You have loved us. Amen.
